svg.title: Black Relief with White
svg.desc: Interpretive study after an actually inspected primary reference. Geometry and interpretive screen colour approximate. Black trapezoidal raised panel on a rectangular white backing; the white backing is part of the work and retained. The oblique photographed outline has been approximately flattened. No identity with another same-title relief is asserted. Foundation photograph explicitly labels this title and EK identifier; medium classification remains as sourced. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of black, white; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://ellsworthkelly.org/exhibition/ellsworth-kelly-curated-by-jack-shear/; catalogue record foundation-exhib-v4-ek946-ellsworth-kelly-curated-by-jack-shear; inspected2026-10-27. Pure editable vector study, not photographic facsimile.
